data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to 18 tons this month; each of the other 24, please state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but risks next stock100. This needn't maximize long-run income; intentions aren't enforceable, and other allocations require recalculation.
